paragraphs: R' Yose bar Pinchas. See the entry R' Yose ben Petros.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has bar Pinchas and the target ben Petros. Both relationship words and differing patronymics remain distinct. The heading was recorded as provisional; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
